name: Can I integrate a TV or artwork above my custom fireplace surround?

mainEntity.name: Can I integrate a TV or artwork above my custom fireplace surround?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, integrating a TV or artwork above a custom fireplace surround is a popular design choice, but it requires careful planning. Considerations include heat dissipation from the fireplace, viewing height, and the structural support needed for mounting. For TVs, specialized heat-resistant mounting options and adequate clearance are essential. We can design the surround to accommodate these elements, ensuring both aesthetics and functionality. Discussing this during the design phase allows for proper integration and material selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Integrating a TV or artwork above the fireplace is possible with careful planning for heat, viewing height, and structural support. Discuss this during the design phase.
